newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to exempt some pork imports from tariffs.
newsitem.headline: Japan to exempt some pork imports from tariffs.

text.p: Japan will exempt some pork imports from tariffs during August as a way to lower domestic pork prices, the Agriculture Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said tariffs would not be applied when pork import prices exceeded 561.06 yen per kg during August.
Domestic pork prices have risen sharply since Japan banned imports of pork from Taiwan in March due to an outbreak of foot and mouth disease there.
Expected lower pork production in Japan this summer is also behind the decision, a ministry official told reporters.
On July 1, the Japanese government lifted an emergency import tariff on pork that had been put in place on April 1 to limit the influx of foreign pork.
